title: Operator Separation, KMS/HSM Partitioning, SAML Token Hardening: Requirements & Sign-off Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD and acceptance playbook for hardening Private deployment security boundaries. Focus areas: operator separation-of-duties, multi-tenant KMS key scoping and HSM partitioning, SAML/SSO token replay and attribute mapping protections, RBAC least-privilege surface, and immutable/signed audit-streams required for regulatory evidence packages.
background: Customers running Private or VPC deployments require demonstrable controls for key custody, operator access boundaries, and tamper-evident audit trails. Several enterprise prospects requested explicit guarantees for HSM partitioning and proof-of-integrity for audit logs, along with SSO integrations that defend against token replay and attribute spoofing.
requirements: SSO/SAML: Support IdP metadata rotation without downtime; validate assertions with multiple public keys; require audience and recipient checks; support encrypted assertions for PII-sensitive fields.
SAML token hardening: Implement nonce/replay cache with TTL configurable per-customer (default 5 minutes); provide proof tests showing tokens rejected on replay and expired tokens are not accepted.

Attribute mapping: Allow customer-configurable attribute-to-role mapping with regex validators and denylist options; changes must be auditable and require admin approval where role grants escalate access.

RBAC: Define canonical role matrix for Private deployments covering Operator, Platform Admin, Key Custodian, Auditor, and Read-only Support; implement role inheritance prevention for high-privilege roles.

KMS/HSM partitioning: Support logical partitioning of HSM (e.g., separate key domains per customer or tenant) with operator inability to export unwrapped key material; require HSM-backed key attestation for keys used for signing audit roots.
Key lifecycle: Automatic rotation schedules configurable per-customer; zero-downtime rewrap support; emergency key revocation procedure documented and tested.
Audit logs: Provide append-only signed audit stream where each daily bundle contains a root hash signed by an HSM key; allow customers to pull signed roots for independent verification.
Evidence packaging: Provide a downloadable evidence package for audits containing signed daily roots, config snapshots, RBAC change history, and SSO metadata change log.
Operational controls: Ensure operator separation-of-duties by enforcing dual-approve flows for any key-escrow or emergency export actions and require recorded justification stored in immutable audit.

Testing & compliance: Include automated regression tests that exercise SAML replay protection, HSM partition enforcement (attempted cross-partition access must be denied), and RBAC escalation attempts are blocked and logged.
non_goals: Providing a managed HSM appliance to the customer (we integrate with customer HSM or cloud KMS only).
Replacing customer IdP governance or offering IdP-side protections beyond standard SAML/SCIM integrations.
acceptance_criteria: IdP metadata rotation performed with zero 5xxs in acceptance cluster and documented step-by-step playbook.
SAML replay test: replayed assertion rejected and logged; test artifacts include request/response traces and replay cache entries.
RBAC: Role grant matrix unit tests cover at least 95% of high-risk grants and prevent direct assignment of 'Key Custodian' and 'Platform Admin' to same user by policy enforcement.
HSM partitioning: Penetration test shows no cross-partition key read/export and HSM attestation report present in evidence package.
Signed audit stream: Daily signed root available via API and matches the downloadable evidence bundle; signature verified with HSM public key.
Operator actions that require dual-approval are blocked when only one approver attempts flow; flow recorded in audit with approver identities and rationale.
Documentation: Playbooks for emergency key revocation, evidence extraction, and SSO onboarding published in Confluence with runbook steps and links to test dashboards.
signoff_checklist: Security Review: Threat model updated and security review completed (security_signoff).
Legal/Compliance Review: Data residency and notarization requirements validated for target customers.
Engineering Readiness: Automated tests green on dedicated-qa and staging clusters.
SRE Readiness: Runbook and SLO impacts reviewed; incident playbook attached.
Customer Ops: Onboarding checklist for collecting IdP metadata, KMS policies, and attestation keys prepared.
PenTest: External pentest covering HSM partitioning and RBAC escalation completed and findings remediated.
Audit Evidence: Sample evidence package generated for an internal tenant and signed roots verified.
Executive Signoff: Product, Security, and Customer Success sign off in the PRD.
test_plan: SAML replay harness: generate assertion, accept then replay to verify rejection and log entry.
Attribute fuzz tests: send malformed attributes and confirm denylist/regex rules prevent role elevation.
HSM partition test: create identical key IDs in two partitions and verify operations scoped to partition only.
Key rotation smoke test: rotate a signing key and verify existing signatures remain verifiable until TTL expiry; verify no downtime for active sessions.
Audit stream verification: compute daily bundle root locally and verify signature via HSM public key; test malformed bundle rejection.
progress_updates: 2025-11-12: PRD created — initial scope drafted after customer request from finance vertical.
2025-12-03: Architecture review with infra and cryptography teams; decision to use HSM-backed signing for audit roots.
2026-01-18: Implementation spike completed for replay cache prototype; initial performance numbers show <2ms median lookup for 95% traffic.
2026-02-10: First integration test with customer-managed HSM vendor A succeeded; noted requirement to support vendor-specific attestation formats.
2026-03-02: Draft evidence package generator implemented; awaiting pentest results to finalize sign-off checklist items.
2026-03-10: Security review in progress; requested additional test coverage for emergency key revocation flows.
decisions: Use HSM-backed signing for audit roots instead of software keys to increase tamper-evidence and meet SOC-like expectations.
Replay protection will be implemented as a tunable in the platform with default 5-minute TTL to balance replay window vs IdP clock skew.
Dual-approval required for any operation that could export or escrow key material; tooling will surface justification and approver identities in audit.
review_feedback: Security: Request to include fuzzing for SAML schema variants. Action: add attribute fuzz tests to test_plan.
SRE: Clarify SLO impact of replay cache on latency; engineering to provide benchmark under 99th percentile load.
Customer Success: Add onboarding checklist entry for customers to provide HSM attestation public key in PEM format.
notes: Tradeoffs: Stronger replay protection reduces interoperability risk with some IdPs that use long-lived assertions; mitigation is configuration toggle with explicit warning.
Operational concern: HSM vendor differences may require a normalization service for attestation formats; initial support targets AWS CloudHSM and YubiHSM-like APIs.
Rollout: Beta with 3 pilot customers for Q1 2026, then gradual enablement for new Private deployments after sign-off.
